piece: Dear ImGui (docking) integration into VulkanRenderDevice — editor-only, --editor gated
currentState: No ImGui anywhere: vcpkg.json lists 9 deps, none is imgui; root CMakeLists.txt ends at line 81 (no imgui find_package); third_party/ holds only gif_h/. The engine HUD is the only UI toolkit (drawHudQuad/drawHudText/drawHudTextF in engine/rhi/IRenderDevice.h:617-648). The Vulkan device (engine/rhi/VulkanRenderDevice.cpp) owns every handle ImGui needs and exposes them as private members near line 7561-8300: vkb::Instance m_inst (7561), vkb::Device m_dev (7562, has .device/.physical_device), VkQueue m_gfxQueue (7564), uint32_t m_gfxFamily (7565), VmaAllocator m_alloc (7622), VkSwapchainKHR m_swapchain (8296), VkExtent2D m_extent (8297), VkFormat m_format=B8G8R8A8_UNORM (8298), std::vector<VkImage> m_swapImages / std::vector<VkImageView> m_swapViews (8299-8300). Frame loop: beginFrame() (442) waits inFlight, acquires; endFrame() (662) calls buildAndExecuteGraph (2291) then submits via vkQueueSubmit2 (736) and vkQueuePresentKHR (757). The COMPOSITE pass (3129-3189) writes colorTargetView (= m_swapViews[imageIndex] windowed, 2296-2297) with the ACES-tonemapped LDR result and records the HUD on top via recordHudDraws (3179); a no-command 'present' pass (3247-3254) then transitions that image COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL -> PRESENT_SRC_KHR. The HUD pipeline (createHud, 3646-3648) is the exact template ImGui must mirror: VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo with pColorAttachmentFormats=&m_format, depthAttachmentFormat=UNDEFINED, dynamic-rendering, alpha blend, no depth. Device init enables Vulkan 1.3 dynamicRendering + sync2 (136-139), bufferDeviceAddress, descriptor-indexing (140-153). main.cpp: GLFW window created at 2239 (glfwGetWin32Window passed to DeviceDesc at 2256), device->init at 2270; the interactive game loop is while(!glfwWindowShouldClose) at 8541 with glfwPollEvents at 8565, beginFrame at 9532, all HUD draws inside if(frame.valid), endFrame at 10132. Arg parsing at ~1455-1475 (e.g. --test-editor at 1459); no --editor flag yet. NOTE: an in-flight IBL change already touches this file (kIblCubeFormat/kIblBrdfFormat at 7727-7728, ibl_*.frag in app/CMakeLists 97-100) — this work must land AFTER that clears and rebase onto it.
design:
Goal: add Dear ImGui (docking branch) so the editor can draw panels into the swapchain image AFTER the composite pass, with ZERO cost and ZERO init when not in --editor mode. ImGui stays an editor-only concern; the game's FontRole HUD is untouched.

(1) DEPENDENCY (vcpkg + CMake). Add to vcpkg.json dependencies an object form for imgui with features so the docking branch + both backends come in: {"name":"imgui","features":["docking-experimental","glfw-binding","vulkan-binding"]}. (Verified against the pinned baseline f7f9411: the imgui port exposes exactly these feature ids — docking-experimental selects the docking branch which also gives multi-viewport for the future 2nd-monitor window.) In root CMakeLists.txt after the other find_package lines (~37) add: find_package(imgui CONFIG REQUIRED). Keep ImGui out of the engine static lib's PUBLIC surface to preserve the 'no Vulkan types cross IRenderDevice.h' rule — link it PRIVATE to x3engine in engine/CMakeLists.txt target_link_libraries PRIVATE block (alongside glfw): imgui::imgui. The vcpkg imgui+vulkan-binding/glfw-binding packages compile imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp / imgui_impl_glfw.cpp INTO the port, so no third_party vendoring and no new .cpp in the engine list is required — just the link. (imgui_impl_vulkan needs a Vulkan loader symbol; we already link Vulkan::Vulkan and load via the SDK, and imgui_impl_vulkan uses the prototypes by default, so set IMGUI_IMPL_VULKAN_NO_PROTOTYPES is NOT needed.)

(2) DEVICE-SIDE API (the foundation everyone calls). Add an editor UI surface to IRenderDevice.h as NON-PURE no-op virtuals (so the headless stub / other devices are unaffected and the header stays graphics-API-free — all ImGui types stay in the .cpp):
  - virtual bool initEditorUI(void* glfwWindow) { return false; }   // one-time; pass the GLFWwindow*
  - virtual void beginEditorUI() {}                                 // call after glfwPollEvents, before beginFrame()
  - virtual void endEditorUI() {}                                   // call after all ImGui::* panel code, before device->endFrame()
  - virtual void shutdownEditorUI() {}
  - virtual bool editorUIActive() const { return false; }
Design rationale for the split: ImGui::NewFrame must happen OUTSIDE the device command buffer (it just builds CPU draw data), so beginEditorUI() does ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame + ImGui_ImplGlfw_NewFrame + ImGui::NewFrame. The editor then issues its ImGui::Begin/End/widget calls. endEditorUI() calls ImGui::Render() to FINALIZE ImDrawData and stashes the pointer (m_editorDrawData = ImGui::GetDrawData()); it must run before device->endFrame() so the draw data exists when the graph records. The ACTUAL GPU recording (ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData) happens inside endFrame's graph as a new pass (step 4). This mirrors the established prepare-data-then-record pattern (prepareFrameData at 676 vs recordMeshDraws).

(3) DEVICE IMPL (VulkanRenderDevice.cpp). New members (guarded, all VK_NULL_HANDLE/false by default so a non-editor run never allocates): VkDescriptorPool m_imguiPool, bool m_imguiInit=false, ImDrawData* m_editorDrawData=nullptr. 
  - initEditorUI(void* win): GUARD on (!m_headless && !m_imguiInit). Create a DEDICATED descriptor pool sized for ImGui (1000 COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET flag) — do NOT reuse the bindless or HUD pools. IMGUI_CHECKVERSION(); ImGui::CreateContext(); enable io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable (and optionally ViewportsEnable later). ImGui_ImplGlfw_InitForVulkan((GLFWwindow*)win, true) — the true installs ImGui's GLFW input callbacks CHAINING the existing ones (it preserves prior callbacks, so the game's keyCallback/charCallback/scrollCallback at main.cpp 660-712 still fire). Fill ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo: Instance=m_inst.instance, PhysicalDevice=m_dev.physical_device, Device=m_dev.device, QueueFamily=m_gfxFamily, Queue=m_gfxQueue, DescriptorPool=m_imguiPool, MinImageCount=swap image count, ImageCount=m_swapImages.size(), MSAASamples=VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, UseDynamicRendering=true, and PipelineRenderingCreateInfo{ colorAttachmentCount=1, pColorAttachmentFormats=&m_format, depthAttachmentFormat=VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED } — IDENTICAL to the HUD pipeline at 3646-3648, which is exactly why ImGui composites correctly on the LDR composited image. ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init(&info). Fonts: modern imgui_impl_vulkan (1.90+, which the baseline ships) lazily uploads the font atlas on first RenderDrawData, so no manual command-buffer font upload is needed; if the pinned version is older, do a one-time ImGui_ImplVulkan_CreateFontsTexture() (no args in 1.90+). Set m_imguiInit=true.
  - beginEditorUI()/endEditorUI(): the NewFrame / Render described in (2); endEditorUI sets m_editorDrawData.
  - shutdownEditorUI(): vkDeviceWaitIdle; ImGui_ImplVulkan_Shutdown(); ImGui_ImplGlfw_Shutdown(); ImGui::DestroyContext(); destroy m_imguiPool. Call from device shutdown() if m_imguiInit (add near 282).

(4) RENDER THE DRAW DATA (new graph pass, after composite, before present). In buildAndExecuteGraph (2291), AFTER the composite pass is added (after 3189) and gated on (m_imguiInit && m_editorDrawData && m_editorDrawData->CmdListsCount>0), add an 'editor-ui' RenderPassDesc that: declares ONE ResourceUse on rgColor with layout COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, stage COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT, access COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE, isWrite=true (so the graph derives the dependency from the composite write); usesDynamicRendering=true with a VkRenderingInfo whose pColorAttachments points at an attachment using colorTargetView with loadOp=VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD (PRESERVE the composited scene+HUD — do NOT clear) and storeOp=STORE, renderArea={{0,0},m_extent}. Its record lambda: set viewport/scissor to m_extent, then ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(m_editorDrawData, c). Reuse the existing m_compositeAttach/m_compositeRenderInfo member-storage pattern (add m_editorUiAttach / m_editorUiRenderInfo members so the structs outlive execute(), exactly like comp at 3130/3155). CRITICAL ORDERING: the existing 'present' finalize pass (3247-3254) that transitions COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL -> PRESENT_SRC_KHR must be added AFTER this editor-ui pass so ImGui draws while the image is still a color attachment and the present transition still happens last. Since the editor pass leaves rgColor in COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, the existing present pass works unchanged. The capture-copy path (3198-3241) also still works (it reads rgColor as TRANSFER_SRC after); --screenshot is unaffected because editorUI is never inited headless.

(5) RESIZE. onResize already flags m_needsRecreate; recreateSwapchain (5232) rebuilds m_swapImages/views. ImGui_ImplVulkan does not hold per-swapchain-image framebuffers when using dynamic rendering, so the only needed call is ImGui_ImplVulkan_SetMinImageCount(newCount) if the image count changes — add a one-liner in recreateSwapchain guarded by m_imguiInit. No font/pipeline rebuild needed (format is stable).

(6) MAIN.CPP WIRING (--editor gate). Add bool editorMode at the arg block (~1459) parsing "--editor". After device->init succeeds (2270) and only if(editorMode && window): device->initEditorUI(window). In the interactive loop (8541): right after glfwPollEvents() (8565) and before beginFrame(), call if(editorMode) device->beginEditorUI(); then the editor (the separate P0.1 EditorState host, a sibling piece) issues its ImGui panel calls; immediately before device->endFrame(frame) (10132) call if(editorMode) device->endEditorUI(). Add device->shutdownEditorUI() in the shutdown sequence (~10136) — or rely on the shutdown() auto-call. Because every entry point is a no-op virtual when not inited, a normal game run pays nothing. Input arbitration (ImGui io.WantCaptureMouse/Keyboard vs gameplay) is the editor host's concern, not this piece.

Key APIs introduced: IRenderDevice::initEditorUI/beginEditorUI/endEditorUI/shutdownEditorUI/editorUIActive. Files touched: vcpkg.json (+imgui w/ 3 features), CMakeLists.txt (find_package imgui), engine/CMakeLists.txt (link imgui::imgui PRIVATE), engine/rhi/IRenderDevice.h (+5 no-op virtuals), engine/rhi/VulkanRenderDevice.cpp (members + 4 method impls + 1 graph pass + resize one-liner + shutdown hook), app/main.cpp (--editor flag + 3 call sites). No shader changes, no new .spv (ImGui ships its own pipeline).
dependencies: The in-flight IBL graphics change in VulkanRenderDevice.cpp must land first; rebase this onto it (both edit buildAndExecuteGraph and the post/composite region).
vcpkg must resolve imgui at the pinned baseline f7f9411 with docking-experimental + glfw-binding + vulkan-binding features (verified the port exposes them).
Vulkan 1.3 dynamicRendering + sync2 already enabled in init (present) — required for UseDynamicRendering=true in ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo.
P0.1 Live Editor Mode host (the EditorState-over-live-viewport wiring + the actual ImGui panel code) is a SEPARATE downstream piece; this piece only provides the device surface it calls into.
risks: Pinned-baseline imgui_impl_vulkan version: 1.90+ auto-uploads fonts and PipelineRenderingCreateInfo is a struct field; an older port needs ImGui_ImplVulkan_CreateFontsTexture(cmdbuf) + an end-single-time-command. Verify the resolved imgui version after vcpkg install and branch the font-upload code accordingly.

ImGui_ImplGlfw_InitForVulkan(win,true) installs chained GLFW callbacks; confirm the game's existing keyCallback/charCallback/scrollCallback (main.cpp 660-712) still fire (they should, chaining preserves prior callbacks) and that ImGui does not swallow gameplay input when no panel is focused — arbitrate via io.WantCaptureMouse/Keyboard in the editor host.

Editor-ui pass must be inserted BEFORE the present finalize pass in buildAndExecuteGraph; getting the order wrong (after the PRESENT_SRC transition) is a validation error / black UI. The render-graph derives barriers from declared uses, so declaring rgColor as a COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE after the composite is the correct dependency.

Multi-viewport (2nd-monitor) via ViewportsEnable spins up secondary swapchains the device does not currently manage; defer ViewportsEnable to the dedicated 2nd-monitor piece — enable only DockingEnable here to keep the foundation low-risk.
Descriptor pool sizing: ImGui needs its own FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET pool; reusing the bindless/HUD pools would corrupt them. Allocate a dedicated 1000-sampler pool only when initEditorUI runs.
